Modern networks have grown increasingly complex, heterogeneous, and large-scale, making handcrafted rules-based methods and traditional Machine Learning (ML) approaches alone insufficient to automate network operations. summary_de: Der Artikel beschreibt, wie die Telekommunikationsbranche durch den Einsatz von Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) autonomer wird.

title: Agent Substrate brings high-density, scalable, trusted infrastructure to GKE
description: Today, we are announcing the availability of Agent Substrate on Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE). Agent Substrate is an open-source, secure-by-default agent execution runtime engineered to run millions of sandboxes with 10x higher density than standard container runtimes . Purpose-built for the era of autonomous agents, Substrate delivers sub-500ms resume operations at over 500 suspend/resume activations per second with native zero-trust kernel and network isolation. summary_de: Agent Substrate wird auf Google Kubernetes Engine verfügbar und ermöglicht ein hohes Mass an Dichte und Sicherheit für autonome Agenten.

summary_de: Google Cloud hat Filestore-Agenten-Volumes eingeführt, die eine vollständig verwaltete Speicherung für Arbeitsumgebungen von Agenten bieten.

These functions allow you to diagnose why metrics changed, uncover underlying trends and relationships across the data, and even isolate the true impact of business decisions.
